data_handling.normalization: Per-branch value mean and standard deviation and coordinate scaling, fitted on the training cases of run ahmed-full-main-v2; no validation or test case enters them.
data_handling.preprocessing: Raw native files are read as they are. The model works on non-dimensional rows (pressure coefficient with shear or velocity per free-stream speed); fixed dataset constants convert them to the official field units at the output.
data_handling.sampling: Training: 32768 anchor and 8192 query cells per case and step, drawn at random from 65536 cells kept per case. Inference: every native entity is a query; 32768 anchor cells per case are drawn from the case geometry with seed 0. The anchors pool into 8192 supernodes at inference (2048 in training). Test-time mirror averaging: each case is also predicted mirrored in y (coordinates and normals), the y vector component of that prediction is negated, and the two predictions are averaged; the measured inference compute includes both passes. Float32 matrix products use the TF32 tensor cores at inference. The physical tower runs under bfloat16 autocast at inference (off in training).

inference_compute.measurement_notes: Seconds inside the model calls (input scaling, anchor encoding, tower passes, rows returned to host), summed over 50 cases on one device; dtype bfloat16, query chunk 65536, torch 2.11.0+cu130. Outside the timer: reading raw files and the volume download, the anchor draw, unit conversion and writing the chunks; the cases took 201320 s in all. Cases with more than one finished pass: 0; stopped passes are not counted.
